## Regular expression functions

# Matching behavior from third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/string_functions.md
# Exercise a repeated pattern across chunks, and changes to the pattern within a chunk.
SELECT COUNTIF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(CAST(x AS STRING), r'^[0-9]+$')) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4097)) AS x
=> "4097"

SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(REGEXP_CONTAINS('abc', pattern) AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY offset) FROM UNNEST(['b', 'b', 'z', '', 'b']) AS pattern WITH OFFSET AS offset
=> "true,true,false,true,true"

SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(REGEXP_CONTAINS(b'abc', pattern) AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY offset) FROM UNNEST([b'b', b'b', b'z', b'', b'b']) AS pattern WITH OFFSET AS offset
=> "true,true,false,true,true"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo123bar', r'\d+')
=> "123"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo123bar', r'o(\d)')
=> "1"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo', r'\d')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo', r'(x)?f')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR('a1b2', r'[(]?\d')
=> "1"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('a1b22', r'\d+'), ',')
=> "1,22"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('a1b2', r'(?:[a-z])(\d)'), ',')
=> "1,2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1b2', r'\d', 1, 2)
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1b2', r'\d', 3)
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1', r'\d', 3)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1', r'\d', 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT('ab', r'(a)(b)')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(b, b) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(b, NULL) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(REGEXP_EXTRACT(b'\xff1', b'\\d'))
=> "31"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('', '(abc)?'), ',', 'N')
=> ""

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('ab', '(x)?b'))
=> "1"

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('ab', r'(a)(b)') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(b'a\xffa', b'a'))
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS(b'\xffa', b'a')
=> "true"

SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS('abc', NULL)
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', '', 'x')
=> "xaxbxcx"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'b*', 'x')
=> "xaxcx"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('banana', '(.)a(.)', r'\1\2')
=> "bnana"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('a.b', r'\.', r'\\')
=> "a\\b"

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'abc', r'\1')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'b', r'\x')
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(b'a\xffb', b'\xff', b'-'))
=> "612d62"
